40022978.author: पदार्थः
40022978.content: रसातलं into the netherworld, प्रविष्टायां having entered, वैदेह्यां when Vaidehi (Sita), सर्ववानराः all the monkeys, चुक्रुशुः cried out, साधु excellent, साध्वीति excellent (feminine), मुनयो the sages, रामसन्निधौ in the presence of Rama.

40022978.author: Translation
40022978.content: When Vaidehi entered the netherworld, all the monkeys and sages present before Rama cried out "Excellent! Excellent!"

40022979.author: पदार्थः
40022979.content: दण्डकाष्ठम् a staff, अवष्टभ्य leaning upon, बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः with eyes agitated by tears, अवाक्छिरा with head bowed down, दीनमना with a sorrowful mind, रामो Rama, ह्यासीत् indeed was, सुदुःखितः extremely distressed.

40022979.author: Translation
40022979.content: Leaning upon a staff, with his eyes agitated by tears, his head bowed down, and his mind filled with sorrow, Rama was indeed extremely distressed.

40022980.author: पदार्थः
40022980.content: स He, रुदित्वा having wept, चिरं for a long, कालं time, बहुशो many times, बाष्पम् tears, उत्सृजन् shedding, क्रोधशोकसमाविष्टो overcome by anger and sorrow, रामो Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022980.author: Translation
40022980.content: Having wept for a long time and shedding many tears, Rama, overcome by both anger and sorrow, then spoke these words.

40022981.author: पदार्थः
40022981.content: अभूतपूर्वं unprecedented, शोकं sorrow, मे my, मनः mind, स्प्रष्टुम् to touch, इवेच्छति seems to desire, पश्यतो while I watched, मे my, यथा just as, नष्टा disappeared, सीता Sita, श्रीरिव like the goddess of fortune, रूपिणी embodied.

40022981.author: Translation
40022981.content: My mind seems to desire an unprecedented sorrow, as Sita, who was like the embodied goddess of fortune, disappeared right before my eyes.

40022982.author: पदार्थः
40022982.content: सा That, अदर्शनं disappearance, पुरा formerly, सीता Sita, लङ्कापारे on the other side of Lanka, महोदधेः of the great ocean, ततश्चापि and from there, मयानीता brought by me, किं what, पुनर् again, वसुधातलात् from the surface of the earth.

40022982.author: Translation
40022982.content: Formerly, Sita disappeared on the other side of Lanka, beyond the great ocean, and even from there I brought her back; how much more difficult will it be to retrieve her from the surface of the earth now?

40022983.author: पदार्थः
40022983.content: वसुधे O Earth, देवि O Goddess, भवति (you) are, सीता Sita, निर्यात्यतां let her be brought forth, मम to me, दर्शयिष्यामि I will show, वा or, रोषं anger, यथा so that, माम् me, अवगच्छसि you understand.

40022983.author: Translation
40022983.content: O Goddess Earth, bring forth Sita to me, or else I will show you my wrath so that you understand who I am.

40022984.author: पदार्थः
40022984.content: कामं indeed, श्वश्रूः mother-in-law, मम my, एव indeed, त्वं you, त्वत्सकाशात् from you, हि indeed, मैथिली Maithili (Sita), कर्षता by one who was ploughing, हलहस्तेन with a plough in hand, जनकेन by Janaka, उद्धृता was taken out, पुरा formerly.

40022984.author: Translation
40022984.content: Indeed, you are my mother-in-law, for Maithili was certainly taken out from you by Janaka, who was ploughing with a plough in hand, long ago.

40022985.author: पदार्थः
40022985.content: तस्मात् therefore, निर्यात्यतां let her be brought forth, सीता Sita, विवरं an opening, वा or, प्रयच्छ give, मे to me, पाताले in the netherworld, नाकपृष्ठे on the surface of heaven, वा or, वसेयं I would dwell, सहितः accompanied, तया by her.

40022985.author: Translation
40022985.content: Therefore, bring forth Sita, or grant me an opening, so that I may dwell with her either in the netherworld or on the surface of heaven.

40022986.author: पदार्थः
40022986.content: आनय bring, त्वं you, हि indeed, तां her, सीतां Sita, मत्तः maddened, अहं I, मैथिलीकृते for the sake of Maithili, न not, मे to me, दास्यसि you will give, चेत् if, सीतां Sita, यथारूपां in her true form, महीतले on the surface of the earth.

40022986.author: Translation
40022986.content: You must indeed bring that Sita, as I am maddened for Maithili's sake; if you do not give Sita to me in her true form on the surface of the earth, then...

40022987.author: पदार्थः
40022987.content: सपर्वतवनां with mountains and forests, कृत्स्नां entire, विधमिष्यामि I will destroy, ते your, स्थितम् existence, नाशयिष्यामि I will destroy, अहं I, भूमिं the earth, सर्वम् everything, आपः water, भवतु let it become, इह here.

40022987.author: Translation
40022987.content: I will destroy your entire existence, including all mountains and forests, I will annihilate the earth, and let everything here become water.

40022988.author: पदार्थः
40022988.content: एवं thus, ब्रुवाणे while speaking, काकुत्स्थे to Kakutstha (Rama), क्रोधशोकसमन्विते filled with anger and sorrow, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरगणैः with the hosts of gods, सार्धम् together, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to the delight of the Raghus (Rama).

40022988.author: Translation
40022988.content: While Rama, filled with anger and sorrow, was speaking thus, Brahma, accompanied by the hosts of gods, addressed him.

40022989.author: पदार्थः
40022989.content: राम O Rama, राम O Rama, न not, सन्तापम् sorrow, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought, सुव्रत O virtuous one, स्मर remember, त्वम् you, पूर्वकम् former, भावम् state (of being), मन्त्रम् sacred incantation, च and, अमित्रकर्शन O destroyer of enemies.

40022989.author: Translation
40022989.content: O virtuous Rama, you should not grieve; O destroyer of enemies, remember your ancient divine nature and the sacred incantation.

40022990.author: पदार्थः
40022990.content: न not, खलु indeed, त्वाम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, स्मारयेयम् I would remind, अनुत्तमम् the unsurpassed (state), इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, दुर्धर्ष O unconquerable one, स्मर remember, त्वम् you, जन्म birth, वैष्णवम् divine (Vishnu's).

40022990.author: Translation
40022990.content: O mighty-armed and unconquerable one, I would indeed remind you of your unsurpassed divine nature; at this very moment, remember your divine birth as Vishnu.

40022991.author: पदार्थः
40022991.content: सीता Sita, हि indeed, विमला pure, साध्वी virtuous, तव your, पूर्वपरायणा solely devoted from the beginning, नागलोकम् to the Naga world, सुखम् happily, प्रायात् went, त्वदाश्रयतपोबलात् by the strength of her penance relying on you.

40022991.author: Translation
40022991.content: Indeed, Sita, pure, virtuous, and solely devoted to you from the beginning, happily went to the Naga world by the power of her penance and devotion to you.

40022992.author: पदार्थः
40022992.content: स्वर्गे in heaven, ते your, सङ्गमः union, भूयः again, भविष्यति will be, न no, संशयः doubt, अस्याः of this, तु but, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, यत् what, ब्रवीमि I say, निबोध understand, तत् that.

40022992.author: Translation
40022992.content: There is no doubt that your union with her will happen again in heaven; but understand what I am about to tell you in the midst of this assembly.

40022993.author: पदार्थः
40022993.content: एतदेव this alone, हि indeed, काव्यं poem, ते by you, काव्यानाम् among poems, उत्तमं best, श्रुतम् heard. सर्वं all, विस्तरतः in detail, राम O Rama, व्याख्यास्यति will explain, न not, संशयः doubt.

40022993.author: Translation
40022993.content: This poem, which you have heard, is indeed the best among all poems, and Rama will explain everything in detail without a doubt.

40022994.author: पदार्थः
40022994.content: जन्मप्रभृति from birth onwards, ते your, वीर O hero, सुखदुःखोपसेवनम् experiencing joys and sorrows. भविष्यदुत्तरं and the future, च and, इह here, सर्वं all, वाल्मीकिना by Valmiki, कृतम् composed.

40022994.author: Translation
40022994.content: O hero, Valmiki has composed everything, from your birth and the experiences of joy and sorrow, to the future events that will unfold.

40022995.author: पदार्थः
40022995.content: आदिकाव्यम् this first poem, इदं this, राम O Rama, त्वयि in you, सर्वं all, प्रतिष्ठितम् established. न not, हि indeed, अन्यः another, अर्हति deserves, काव्यानां among poems, यशोभाग्राघवादृते the share of glory, except for Rama.

40022995.author: Translation
40022995.content: O Rama, this primeval poem is entirely founded upon you, and indeed, no one else but you, O Raghava, deserves the glory among poems.

40022996.author: पदार्थः
40022996.content: श्रुतं heard, ते by you, पूर्वम् previously, एतत् this, हि indeed, मया by me, सर्वं all, सुरैः with gods, सह together. दिव्यम् divine, अद्भुतरूपं of wondrous form, च and, सत्यवाक्यम् truthful words, अनावृतम् unconcealed.

40022996.author: Translation
40022996.content: Indeed, I have previously heard all of this, which is divine, of wondrous form, and contains unconcealed truthful words, along with the gods.

40022997.author: पदार्थः
40022997.content: स therefore, त्वं you, पुरुषशार्दूल O best among men, धर्मेण with righteousness, सुसमाहितः well-composed/attentive. शेषं the remaining, भविष्यं future, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, काव्यं poem, रामायणं Ramayana, शृणु listen.

40022997.author: Translation
40022997.content: Therefore, O best among men, O Kakutstha, being well-composed and attentive to righteousness, listen to the remaining future events of the Ramayana poem.

40022998.author: पदार्थः
40022998.content: उत्तरं Uttaram, नाम named, काव्यस्य of the epic poem, शेषम् the remainder, अत्र here, महायशः O greatly renowned one, तत् that, शृणुष्व listen, महातेज O greatly effulgent one, ऋषिभिः with the sages, सार्धम् together with, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022998.author: Translation
40022998.content: O greatly renowned and effulgent Rama, listen here to this excellent concluding part of the epic poem, named Uttara, along with the sages.

40022999.author: पदार्थः
40022999.content: न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by another, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, श्रोतव्यम् to be heard, इदम् this, उत्तमम् excellent, परमम् supreme, ऋषिणा by the sage, वीर O hero, त्वया by you, एव only, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022999.author: Translation
40022999.content: Indeed, O Kakutstha, O hero, O delight of the Raghus, this excellent and supreme work, composed by the sage, is not to be heard by anyone else, but only by you.

40023000.author: पदार्थः
40023000.content: एतावत् thus much, उक्त्वा having said, वचनम् the word, ब्रह्मा Brahma, त्रिभुवनेश्वरः the lord of the three worlds, जगाम went, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, देवः the god, देवैः with the gods, सह together with, सबान्धवैः with his relatives.

40023000.author: Translation
40023000.content: Having spoken thus, Brahma, the lord of the three worlds, the god, went to heaven along with the other gods and his associates.

40023001.author: पदार्थः
40023001.content: ये those who, च and, तत्र there, महात्मानः great-souled ones, ऋषयः sages, ब्राह्मलौकिकाः belonging to Brahma's world, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समनुज्ञाताः permitted, न्यवर्तन्त returned, महौजसः greatly powerful ones, उत्तरम् the Uttara Kanda, श्रोतुमनसः desirous to hear, भविष्यम् the future, यत् which, च and, राघवे regarding Rama.

40023001.author: Translation
40023001.content: And those great-souled, greatly powerful sages from Brahma's world, who were desirous to hear the Uttara Kanda and the future events concerning Rama, returned after being permitted by Brahma.

40023002.author: पदार्थः
40023002.content: ततः then, रामः Rama, शुभाम् auspicious, वाणीम् speech, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, भाषिताम् spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमतेजस्वी most effulgent, वाल्मीकिम् to Valmiki, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

40023002.author: Translation
40023002.content: Then, the most effulgent Rama, having heard the auspicious words spoken by Brahma, the god of gods, said this to Valmiki.

40023003.author: पदार्थः
40023003.content: भगवन् O venerable one, श्रोतुमनसः desirous of hearing, ऋषयः sages, ब्राह्मलौकिकाः from Brahma's realm, भविष्यत् future, उत्तरम् latter part, यत् which, मे by me, श्वोभूते on the morrow, सम्प्रवर्तताम् let it be commenced.

40023003.author: Translation
40023003.content: Valmiki addresses the venerable sages from Brahma's realm, expressing his desire for the future, latter part of his Ramayana to be commenced on the following day for them to hear.

40023004.author: पदार्थः
40023004.content: एवम् thus, विनिश्चयम् decision, कृत्वा having made, सम्प्रगृह्य having taken, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, तम् that, जनौघम् multitude of people, विसृज्य having dismissed, अथ then, पर्णशालाम् to the hermitage, उपागमत् he went, ताम् that, एव indeed, शोचतः lamenting, सीताम् for Sita, सा that, व्यतीयाय passed away, शर्वरी night.

40023004.author: Translation
40023004.content: Having made this decision and accepted Kusha and Lava, Rama dismissed the crowd and returned to his hermitage, where that night passed as he grieved for Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टनवतितमः सर्गः ।। 98 ।। Thus ends the ninety-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
